topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, introduces the lecture's focus on cancer evolution, and outlines the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer evolves through Darwinian clonal selection driven by the acquisition of genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell properties and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stemness characteristics, hierarchical tissue organization, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate to drive neoplastic growth.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and spatial heterogeneity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic surveys the experimental sequencing, spatial profiling, and computational modeling methods used to study cancer evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrative evolutionary model of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational accumulation, epigenetic plasticity, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental pressures into an overarching evolutionary framework.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
